children: TotalEnergies SE (EURONEXT:TTE) is reshaping its portfolio—selling its Arctic LNG 2 stake while keeping ~$1.3B in loan claims, cancelling a U.S. wind lease for conventional project commitments, hiring an exploration lead for Norway, buying Brazilian crude lots, and positioning as an AI/data-center power supplier.
TotalEnergies Sees 1.3B Shareholder Loans, Arctic LNG 2 Stake Sold
: TotalEnergies (TTE) sold its 10% stake in Arctic LNG 2 to NordLine; it no longer holds equity but retains a contractual claim to about $1.3B in shareholder loans, subject to future sanctions.
TotalEnergies Agrees To Cancel Offshore Wind Lease
: TotalEnergies (TTE) agreed with the U.S. government to cancel an offshore wind lease in exchange for commitments to invest in conventional energy projects.
TotalEnergies To Hire Stavanger Exploration Manager
: TotalEnergies (TTE) to hire exploration manager in Stavanger to review Norway continental shelf projects; CEO Pouyanne says capital will target geologically viable developments.
TotalEnergies Buys 4 Million Barrels From Búzios
: TotalEnergies (TTE) bought three lots totaling 4 million barrels of Brazilian spot crude from the Búzios field in a PPSA auction; remaining lots unsold and to be re-offered in September.
TotalEnergies Named Key AI Power Supplier
: TotalEnergies (TTE) identified as a key supplier for AI and data-center power demand, placing it among major oil and gas peers targeted to provide electricity for growing AI infrastructure.
